title: The Reign Takes Shape
description: That will do for a beginning, Sire. Browns answer your call, and the Tower possesses at least one room whose purpose extends beyond echoing impressively. We have enough of a foundation now to stop pretending the world will arrange itself for our convenience. Pursue whatever strengthens your rule. Opportunities need not be taken in the order they present themselves, and I shall interrupt when one becomes important enough to deserve you.
description_completed: The Overlord has restored the Brown Minions and the Tower's first practical infrastructure. Several major opportunities may now be pursued as their real prerequisites become available.

prerequisites.name: Establish the Tower's first practical infrastructure

rewards.name: Record the initial foundation of the reign
